paite: Babulon tanu nungak aw, hongsuk inla, leivuiah tuin; Kaldai tanu aw, laltutphah lou-ah leiah tuin: om nou leh nuamsa honchi nawn lou ding uhi.
english: “Come down, and sit in the dust, virgin daughter of Babylon; sit on the ground without a throne, daughter of the Chaldeans: for you shall no more be called tender and delicate.

paite: Buh gawijanna suangte la inla, tangbuang bawlin: nakikhuhna puan koih inla, na ten tual lem inla, na khe hong inla, luite ngap galkahin.
english: Take the millstones, and grind meal; remove your veil, strip off the train, uncover the leg, pass through the rivers.

paite: Na vuaktanna khuhlouin a om dinga, ahi, na zahmoh a dawk ding: phu ka la dinga, mi kuamah ka kithuahpih kei ding.
english: Your nakedness shall be uncovered, yes, your shame shall be seen: I will take vengeance, and will spare no man.”

paite: A hontanpa, a min sepaihte Toupa ahi, Israelte Mi Siangthou.
english: Our Redeemer, Yahweh of Armies is his name, the Holy One of Israel.

paite: Kaldai tanu aw, dai didein tu inla, mial nuaiah lutin, Gam cih lalnu honchi ta kei ding uh hi.
english: “Sit in silence, and go into darkness, daughter of the Chaldeans; for you shall no more be called the mistress of kingdoms.

paite: Ka mite tungah ka heha, ka goutan ka hihthanghuaia, na khutah ka honpia hi: nang a tunguah hehpihna himhim na langsak kei a; teklamte tungah nangawng na hakkol giktak na ngata hi.
english: I was angry with my people, I profaned my inheritance, and gave them into your hand: you showed them no mercy; on the aged you have very heavily laid your yoke.

paite: Huan, Kei khantawnin lalnu dingin ka om ding, na chi a: huchiin huai thilte lah na lungsimin na ngaihtuah keia, a tawpna ding lah na theigige sam kei hi.
english: You said, ‘I shall be a mistress forever;’ so that you did not lay these things to your heart, nor did you remember the latter end of it.

paite: Huchiin nang nuamtata om, awlmohneilou-a om, lungsima, Keimah ka hi, kei mah lou mi dang himhim a om kei uh, meithaiin ka tu kei dinga, tate tan thu lah ka thei sam kei ding, chinu, hiai theiin:
english: “Now therefore hear this, you who are given to pleasures, who sit securely, who say in your heart, ‘I am, and there is none else besides me; I shall not sit as a widow, neither shall I know the loss of children:’

paite: Hiai thil nih, tate tanna leh meithainain, ni khat thuin mitphiatkal louin a honpha ding ahi: na bumna zatna tamngialin, na kivenna tam kuam mahleh, huaite nakpitakin na tungah a hongtung ding hi.
english: but these two things shall come to you in a moment in one day, the loss of children, and widowhood; in their full measure shall they come on you, in the multitude of your sorceries, and the great abundance of your enchantments.

paite: Na gitlouhna muanga; Kuamahin honmuse kei uh, na chi vial ngala; na pilna leh na theihnain honhihsia hi: Keimah ka hi, kei lou midang himhim a om kei, na lungsimin na chibehlap hi.
english: For you have trusted in your wickedness; you have said, No one sees me; your wisdom and your knowledge, it has perverted you, and you have said in your heart, I am, and there is none else besides me.

paite: Huaijiakin thil hoihlou na tungah a hongtung dinga; a ven dan na siam kei ding: vangtahnain a honbuak dinga; huai lah na hihmang theikei ding: siatna leng thakhatin na tungah hongtung guih dinga; huai na theikhol kei ding.
english: Therefore evil will come on you; you won’t know when it dawns: and mischief will fall on you; you will not be able to put it away: and desolation shall come on you suddenly, which you don’t know.

paite: Na kikauna leh bumna na zatna, naupang nou na hih akipana na kisukgimnate, dinpih tanla; na phattuampih theih ding phota, na zohpih theih ding phot leh.
english: “Stand now with your enchantments, and with the multitude of your sorceries, in which you have labored from your youth; if so be you shall be able to profit, if so be you may prevail.

paite: Na lemtheih a tam mahmah jiakin na gimta hi: tuin van thutheite, aksi-enmite, kha tenga thugekholmite ding uhenla, na tunga thil hongtung dingte laka kipanin honhong le uh a ke.
english: You are wearied in the multitude of your counsels: let now the astrologers, the stargazers, the monthly prognosticators, stand up, and save you from the things that shall come on you.

paite: Ngaiin, buhpawl bang lel ahi ding ua; meiin a kang ding; meikuang thilhihtheihna laka kipan a kihumbit kei ding uh: hihlumna ding meihol bang ahi kei dinga, awi ding mei bang lah ahi sam kei ding.Huchibangin na kihihgim nakna thilte nanga dingin a om ding uhi: na naupan nou akipana na laka sumsinmite amau lampi chiatah a vak mang ding ua; honhumbit ding kuamah himhim a om kei ding uh.
english: Behold, they shall be as stubble; the fire shall burn them; they shall not deliver themselves from the power of the flame: it shall not be a coal to warm at, nor a fire to sit before.

paite: Huchibangin na kihihgim nakna thilte nanga dingin a om ding uhi: na naupan nou akipana na laka sumsinmite amau lampi chiatah a vak mang ding ua; honhumbit ding kuamah himhim a om kei ding uh.
english: Thus shall the things be to you in which you have labored: those who have trafficked with you from your youth shall wander everyone to his quarter; there shall be none to save you.
